test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'CABLES' is written as 'ECDUGN' and ‘PHONES’ is written as ‘RJQUGP’. How will 'MOBILE' be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets & their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84a5e7eac13b1cbbdf8f3042f0336defa9455cbddac28854332b45ea9553f521.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**The alphabets are increased by 2.**

**The fourth & sixth alphabets are interchanged.**

Now,

'CABLES' is written as 'ECDUGN'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa57d9eef0065773c06e484c1cd9a09cf72b6b0c12756ff9456df4d5750e0622.png] 

‘PHONES’ is written as ‘RJQUGP’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25663c14b2ba697aa5dd8b204cec87b2fc75f3bc7d7f6c8339362a9dcb70bf8e.png] 

So, MOBILE can be written as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0324d9427826c42c2807985134f91ddeae4c3c9a75f40b12187040e25d00c1a.png] 

So, 'MOBILE’ is written as ‘OQDGNK’.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
